audience: shop and warehouse teams that track stock, buy and sell orders in Inventory Now

useCases.title: Check stock on hand for an item
useCases.text: Search items by text, category, location or stock status. Open one item for its stock, expenses and profit figures.

useCases.title: Review buy and sell orders from the last week
useCases.text: List orders, newest first. Use the updated-since filter to see cancellations. Open one order for its lines and profit.

useCases.title: Read the inventory totals and account labels
useCases.text: Read the sum, count, bought and sold totals of the whole inventory. Read the labels for categories, locations and custom fields.

useCases.title: Record a buy or sell order
useCases.text: Record a buy order to add stock, or a sell order to remove it. A sale above the stock on hand fails unless back orders are on.

useCases.title: Cancel an order and restore its stock
useCases.text: Cancel an order. The stock counts it moved are reversed, and the order stays on record as cancelled.

useCases.title: Add a new item or update its details
useCases.text: Create an item with a stable internal id, so a retry is safe. Update item fields; stock changes only through orders.
